zh-CN.title: 统一消息输入体验
items: 欢迎语和群发消息直接复用聊天输入区：桌面上方工具栏，手机下方图标栏
欢迎语支持选择云端文件，群发保留本地附件；统一明暗外观与输入体验

en.title: One consistent message composer
items: Welcome and broadcast editors now reuse the chat composer, with desktop top tools and mobile bottom tools
Choose cloud files for welcome messages and local attachments for broadcasts, with consistent light and dark styling
